articles.title: Elizabeth Holmes Documentary Rolls Out
articles.summary: A new documentary about Elizabeth Holmes titled 'You Can See Everything' has earned over $100 million worldwide and is now beginning its international theatrical and streaming release rollout.

articles.title: OpenAI Chief Scientist Discusses AI Limits
articles.summary: OpenAI's chief scientist shares perspectives on how to establish effective speed limits for artificial intelligence development, emphasizing that nations and researchers must first agree on reliable metrics to measure progress.

articles.title: Top Apps for Making New Friends
articles.summary: A curated list highlights various smartphone applications designed to help adults meet new people, ranging from dedicated friend discovery platforms like BFF to event-focused services like Timeleft.

articles.title: Data Centers Fuel Big Tech Backlash
articles.summary: Journalist Paris Marx discusses his new book titled 'Hyperscale,' which examines why massive data centers have become a central focal point for the growing public and regulatory backlash against Big Tech.

articles.title: TechCrunch Mobility Explores AI and Transit
articles.summary: The latest installment of TechCrunch Mobility explores the rapidly evolving future of transportation, with a specific focus on A/B testing autonomous robots against human drivers and the increasing role of artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Can a Television Be Too Large?
articles.summary: An analysis explores whether modern televisions are reaching an impractical size, detailing the unexpected spatial and logistical challenges encountered after upgrading to a 65-inch OLED display in a standard living space.

articles.title: Signal Restricts Screenshots Against AI Surveillance
articles.summary: Messaging app Signal is actively restricting users' ability to capture mobile screenshots on both its Android and iOS platforms as part of its ongoing efforts to combat the existential threat of automated AI surveillance.

articles.title: Contrasting Reports Highlight Nvidia's Status
articles.summary: Recent financial earnings reports offer a starkly different perspective on Nvidia when compared to the vocal demands from certain tech executives calling for the return or intervention of CEO Jensen Huang.

articles.title: Trump Comments on Reported FBI Database Hack
articles.summary: Donald Trump has publicly described a reported cyberattack against the National Crime Information Center database as troubling, while federal authorities continue their active investigation into the security breach.

articles.title: Notable AI Agents for Text Messages
articles.summary: A comprehensive roundup details the most prominent artificial intelligence agents capable of integrating directly into text messaging platforms, offering specialized assistance for families, travelers, work tasks, and general daily management.

articles.title: Actor Licenses Face to Microdrama Startup
articles.summary: A growing trend in China has spread as an actor licenses an AI-generated version of his face to a microdrama startup, prompting industry experts to question the long-term consequences for traditional Hollywood production models.

articles.title: Alaska Governor-Elect Is Prolific Wikipedia Editor
articles.summary: Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins, the newly elected governor of Alaska, has drawn attention for his extensive digital background, which includes making more than 13,000 edits to the online encyclopedia Wikipedia.

articles.title: Experts Warn of Future Major Tech Outages
articles.summary: Following a disruptive wave of recent incidents including an FAA ground stop, an extended Outlook failure, and banking issues at JPMorgan Chase, intelligence officials warn that the public should expect more widespread infrastructure outages.

articles.title: Delta Flights Delayed by Atlanta System Outage
articles.summary: Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport faced significant flight delays for Delta Air Lines after a critical technical failure affected the system responsible for calculating aircraft weight and balance parameters.

articles.title: Developer Removes AI Music After Review Bomb
articles.summary: The creators of The Binding of Isaac: Repentance Plus removed AI-generated songs from a Grand Theft Auto-themed section of the game after Steam users discovered Suno metadata and launched a review-bombing campaign.

articles.title: Nintendo Discounts Switch 2 Games for Black Friday
articles.summary: Nintendo is offering rare holiday discounts for Black Friday, knocking $20 off select Nintendo Switch 2 video games and reducing the price of a primary console bundle by $50 for a limited time.

articles.title: Sheherazaad Releases Debut Folk Album Khudgarzi
articles.summary: Following her early success with the EP Qasr, artist Sheherazaad has released her debut Urdu-language folk-noir LP, Khudgarzi, which blends traditional Carnatic and Hindustani musical instrumentation with modern reverb-drenched production styles.

articles.title: Protesters Storm Meta Offices in India
articles.summary: Members and youth wing representatives of India's opposition Congress party protested outside and entered Meta's Delhi offices, demanding the restoration of suspended politician accounts and threatening further demonstrations against the company.

articles.title: Nintendo Cuts Switch 2 Price for Black Friday
articles.summary: Nintendo announced a temporary $50 price reduction on one of its main Switch 2 console bundles, running from late November through early December to capture holiday shoppers seeking seasonal hardware discounts.

articles.title: Immersive Audio Experience at SoHo Playhouse
articles.summary: Visitors attending a performance at the historic SoHo Playhouse in New York City are greeted by ushers handing out specialized wired headphones connected to Auracast technology for an enhanced auditory theater experience.

articles.title: How Tamagotchis Pioneered Digital Pet Craze
articles.summary: Originally launched in the late 1990s, Tamagotchis became an overnight global sensation that hooked millions of children on caring for demanding, high-maintenance digital creatures that required constant feeding and attention.

articles.title: Testing Audio Capabilities of Apple HomeView
articles.summary: Further testing of Apple's HomeView smart display highlights its ongoing audio performance, integration with third-party music applications, and several user frustrations regarding its functionality as a dedicated smart speaker.

articles.title: GLP-1 Drugs Could Free Up Vast Farmland
articles.summary: New analyses indicate that widespread adoption of GLP-1 weight-loss medications could significantly decrease global food demand, potentially freeing up an amount of agricultural farmland larger than the entire country of Italy.

articles.title: Director Returns With Godzilla Minus Zero
articles.summary: Director Takashi Yamazaki successfully expands the iconic monster franchise with Godzilla Minus Zero, pitting the legendary creature against one of its most formidable historical foes in a critically acclaimed sequel.

articles.title: Genetics Debunks Claims of Race Realism
articles.summary: Modern genetic research demonstrates that pseudoscientific concepts of race realism are scientifically invalid and entirely unsupported by empirical data regarding innate differences in human intelligence.

articles.title: FCC Preempts California Phone Service Rules
articles.summary: The Trump administration's Federal Communications Commission has formally declared that California lacks the authority to enforce state-level regulations that mandate telecom companies like AT&T to maintain traditional landline phone services.

articles.title: Starshield Changes Threaten SpaceX Military Business
articles.summary: Recent operational changes made to SpaceX's Starshield satellite service in Ukraine have sparked intense scrutiny and questions that could potentially impact the company's broader military contracting business portfolio.

articles.title: Google Redesigns Search Homepage with AI Chat
articles.summary: Google has updated its primary search homepage to feature integrated AI chat history while removing the traditional search button, streamlining user access to artificial intelligence tools directly from the browser landing page.

articles.title: Meta Reevaluates Net-Zero Goal Due to AI Data
articles.summary: Driven by record energy consumption and surging carbon emissions from powering AI data centers, Meta is officially reevaluating its aggressive 2030 corporate sustainability and net-zero environmental targets.

articles.title: Canary Test Exposes AI Supply Chain Flaws
articles.summary: A security researcher planted unique trackable canary phrases into the artificial intelligence data supply chain, revealing a major privacy disaster that proved sensitive training data does not remain secure.

articles.title: Astronomers Witness Star Swallow Neighbor
articles.summary: A sudden and dramatic brightening event observed in deep space was confirmed to be the result of a massive star that was orbiting directly inside another stellar body before being consumed and exploding.

articles.title: NASA Refines New Artemis Moon Landing Plan
articles.summary: While NASA continues to make formal progress and shape its updated strategy for returning humans to the lunar surface, aerospace experts note that significant technical discussions and debates remain unresolved.

articles.title: Contraband Phone Jamming Raises Interference Fears
articles.summary: Although prisons have received federal approval to use signal jamming technology against contraband mobile devices, industry group CTIA warns that testing demonstrates the interference can accidentally block nearby consumer phones up to two and a half miles away.

articles.title: Army Delays Hazardous Lead Azide Detonation
articles.summary: Amid intense public fear and political pushback, the U.S. Army has postponed plans to detonate a batch of catastrophically hazardous lead azide after predictive models indicated a neurotoxic plume could travel up to 100 miles.

articles.title: Weighing the Pros and Cons of Location Sharing
articles.summary: While sharing your digital location offers clear practical benefits such as recovering lost hardware and ensuring personal safety during night outings, users must carefully evaluate the privacy trade-offs before opting in.

articles.title: Can You Safely Charge an iPhone with 140W?
articles.summary: An analysis explores whether using a heavy-duty 140-watt power adapter on a standard iPhone is safe, concluding that while the device will only draw what it requires, specific technical nuances apply.
